answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can trade, with slashing if it misbehaves. A single honest voyage of verified deliveries builds a reputation that cannot be bought cheaply, while a fake swarm must fund each identity separately, so the cost ripples across every copy. Like shale layers that only form under sustained pressure over time, trust accrues slowly through repeated, checkable work, making mass forgery expensive and unprofitable.
